title: 媽祖聖誕祝壽法會
description: 萬春宮媽祖聖誕祝壽祭典，歡迎信眾一同參與祝壽、參拜祈福。
descriptionEn: Wanchun Temple's annual birthday ceremony for Mazu — join us for the celebration and blessing rituals.

title: 旱溪媽祖遶境十八庄
description: 台中重要宗教盛事，媽祖神轎遶境十八庄，沿途信眾夾道祈福。
descriptionEn: One of Taichung's major religious events — Mazu's palanquin processes through eighteen villages.

title: 冬季偏鄉送暖計畫
description: 萬春宮冬令平安米供養，隨喜護持偏鄉獨居長者與弱勢家庭。
descriptionEn: Wanchun Temple's winter relief program supporting elderly and low-income households in rural areas.

title: 平安燈油添香活動
description: 城隍廟平安燈油添香活動，您的贊助將用於廟宇日常香油與維護。
descriptionEn: Support the City God Temple's daily incense and maintenance costs.
